summary: Frontend-only validation of Ripe Reads 65-book / 16-vibes expansion. Visited home, book pages (Percy Jackson, ACOMAF), series (ACOTAR, Empyrean, index), vibes (books-like-fourth-wing, after-percy-jackson, lists index), hubs (ages 10-12, 18-plus; grades middle-school), challenged, find, quiz; validated sitemap/llms/robots; checked mobile overflow at 390px. All structural assertions pass with the exception of task-spec drift noted below (not bugs in the app). Zero console errors on home, a book page, a vibe page, and a series page.

percy_jackson_book_page.quick_answers_first_dt: What age is Percy Jackson and the Lightning Thief appropriate for?

quiz.quiz_results_sample: 7 titles fit your lines; Band 10-12; sorted gentlest first (Percy Jackson, Aru Shah, Artemis Fowl...)

task_spec_drift_notes: Task spec lists band ids 'home-band-13-14 … home-band-17-plus'; actual AGE_BANDS slugs are 10-12, 12-14, 14-16, 16-18, 18-plus. All 5 tiles exist and have non-zero counts; drift is in the task description, not the app.

Task spec says /find/ with 'riordan' shows 1 result; actual = 2 (Percy Jackson and the Lightning Thief + Aru Shah and the End of Time, both authored/related by Rick Riordan imprint). Expected after expansion.
Task spec says /grades/middle-school/ shows 25 rows; actual = 29 after expansion to 65 titles.
Series index linked unique /series/<slug>/ hrefs = 57 (>= 40 required).
critical_code_review_comments: No critical issues observed. Content expansion is wired through consistently (home grid 65, sitemap 65, llms.txt 65 books / 16 vibes).
Minor: FW vibe page has a single <svg data-testid='pin-card'> at page level rather than per-row; row chips (row-band-*, row-signal-*) do exist per row as required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static CRA frontend only. Age band slugs are 10-12/12-14/14-16/16-18/18-plus (not 13-14/15-16/17-plus). Find input is <input type=text placeholder='Fourth Wing, Bardugo, dragons.'>; band filter is a native <select>. Vibe row chips use data-testid row-band-<slug> and row-signal-<slug>; book rows use data-testid book-row-<slug>. llms.txt sections headed '## Books' and '## Vibes lists'. ACOTAR maturity drift SVG x-axis labels render as '#1 · 16+' and '#2 · 18+'.
